flow_overview: An online careers portal that lets applicants discover MBTA job openings, refine results with filters and sorting, inspect detailed postings, and initiate an application.
capability_summary: Career landing and job openings access
Job detail inspection and application initiation

requirements.text: The system shall allow users to sort job listings by multiple criteria, including posting date, title, and salary.
requirements.rationale: The requested sort criteria are visibly available.

claims.claim: The Sort panel exposes multiple sorting criteria, including posting date, job title, and salary.
claims.claim_text: The Sort panel exposes multiple sorting criteria, including posting date, job title, and salary.

requirements.evidence_note: The sort panel lists Posting Date, Job Title, and Salary options.

requirements.text: The system shall present comprehensive job details before application, including salary, location, job type, job number, closing information, department, and full descriptive content.
requirements.rationale: The required detail information is visible before application.

claims.claim: The detailed job view shows salary, location, job type, job number, closing information, department, and descriptive content before application.
claims.claim_text: The detailed job view shows salary, location, job type, job number, closing information, department, and descriptive content before application.

requirements.evidence_note: The detail flyout shows the requested metadata, Description content, and an Apply button.

requirements.text: The system shall provide an explicit action for applicants to begin applying from the detailed job view.
requirements.rationale: The explicit application entry action is visible.

claims.claim: The detailed job view includes a visible Apply action.
claims.claim_text: The detailed job view includes a visible Apply action.

requirements.evidence_note: The Safety Lead Investigator detail flyout has an Apply button.

requirements.text: The system shall support a downstream application workflow after the applicant selects Apply for a job.
requirements.rationale: The entry point is supported, but the downstream workflow is missing from the flow.

claims.claim: The selected job detail view provides an Apply control.
claims.claim_text: The selected job detail view provides an Apply control.

claims.claim: The downstream application workflow after Apply is not shown.
claims.claim_text: The downstream application workflow after Apply is not shown.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 14 shows Apply, but no later application form or workflow is visible.

requirements.text: The system shall allow users to create a job alert directly from their current search and filter context so future matching openings can be delivered without re-entering the criteria.
requirements.rationale: The general alert capability is supported, while current-context persistence is missing or hidden.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow users to subscribe to job posting alerts for future openings.

claims.claim: A general job-alert sign-up mechanism is visible.
claims.claim_text: A general job-alert sign-up mechanism is visible.

claims.claim: No job-alert creation control tied directly to the current filtered search context is shown.
claims.claim_text: No job-alert creation control tied directly to the current filtered search context is shown.

claims.claim: Future delivery of matching openings without re-entering criteria depends on hidden persistence and notification behavior.
claims.claim_text: Future delivery of matching openings without re-entering criteria depends on hidden persistence and notification behavior.

requirements.evidence_note: General alert signup is visible, but save-current-search or alert-from-current-filter behavior is not visible.

requirements.text: The system shall provide visible confirmation that a selected job posting has been handed off to the chosen external sharing channel or compose surface.
requirements.rationale: Only the entry mechanism is supported; the required confirmation is missing.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall support sharing job postings through external channels such as social media and email.

claims.claim: Sharing-style controls are visible for job postings.
claims.claim_text: Sharing-style controls are visible for job postings.

claims.claim: No selected external sharing channel, compose surface, or visible handoff confirmation is shown.
claims.claim_text: No selected external sharing channel, compose surface, or visible handoff confirmation is shown.

requirements.evidence_note: Sharing affordances are visible, but no sharing action or confirmation appears.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that every job shown after search and filtering satisfies all selected criteria across the complete result set, not only the initially visible listings.
requirements.rationale: Visible local consistency is supported, but the universal correctness claim cannot be fully proven.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall keep the displayed result set consistent with the selected filter criteria and the reported jobs found count.

claims.claim: After filtering, the UI reports three jobs and displays three visible postings.
claims.claim_text: After filtering, the UI reports three jobs and displays three visible postings.

claims.claim: Universal correctness across the complete result set depends on data correctness and filtering behavior not fully verifiable from screenshots.
claims.claim_text: Universal correctness across the complete result set depends on data correctness and filtering behavior not fully verifiable from screenshots.

requirements.evidence_note: The UI shows Showing 1-3 of 3 jobs after filtering, but full correctness remains hidden.

requirements.text: The system shall allow public browsing of job listings and posting details, while requiring applicant authentication before entering the application workflow.
requirements.rationale: Public browsing is supported; the authentication policy before application is not verified.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall provide a dedicated careers area from which users can access job openings and related applicant resources.

claims.claim: Public browsing of listings and posting details is visible without an authenticated session.
claims.claim_text: Public browsing of listings and posting details is visible without an authenticated session.

claims.claim: The screenshots do not show whether authentication is required after selecting Apply.
claims.claim_text: The screenshots do not show whether authentication is required after selecting Apply.

requirements.evidence_note: Listings and details are browsable while Sign In is visible, but the post-Apply authentication boundary is not shown.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a visible control on the detailed job view that starts the application workflow for the selected opening.
requirements.rationale: The requirement centers on the visible control, and that control is present.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow users to navigate from a job listing to a detailed view for an individual opening.

claims.claim: The detailed job view provides a visible Apply control for the selected opening.
claims.claim_text: The detailed job view provides a visible Apply control for the selected opening.

claims.claim: Starting the application after pressing Apply is a routine dependency behind the visible control.
claims.claim_text: Starting the application after pressing Apply is a routine dependency behind the visible control.

requirements.evidence_note: The selected Safety Lead Investigator detail flyout includes an Apply button.

requirements.text: The system shall let users remove individual active search or filter criteria directly from the results view and immediately refresh the matching job set.
requirements.rationale: A core observable part of the requirement is contradicted by the active-filter results view.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall provide visible feedback about how many filters are active and which filter categories currently contain selections.

claims.claim: The active-filter results view shows only aggregate active-filter feedback and no individual active filter removal controls.
claims.claim_text: The active-filter results view shows only aggregate active-filter feedback and no individual active filter removal controls.

claims.claim: No individual criterion-removal action with immediate result refresh is shown.
claims.claim_text: No individual criterion-removal action with immediate result refresh is shown.

requirements.evidence_note: The results view shows an aggregate Filter count but no per-criterion remove controls.
